contact_role.description: The role of the person actually reached. Use unknown if the person did not confirm their role or was the wrong person.

reached.description: yes only if a live human answered and engaged about this shipment. no for voicemail, no answer, hang-up, or wrong number. unknown if unclear.

shipment_recognized.description: Whether the contact recognized the shipment reference or load being discussed.

current_status.description: The contact's stated current situation in their own words (truck location for driver/dispatch, dock situation for receiving). Empty if not stated.

revised_eta.description: Driver/dispatch: the revised arrival time as an exact clock time such as '15:40' or '3:40 PM'. Receiving dock: the latest arrival time the dock can still accept the load today, or the slot offered. Leave empty for vague estimates. Never invent a time.

can_accept.description: Receiving dock only: whether the dock will accept the shipment after the promised window. conditional when limited to a cutoff or other stated condition. Other roles: unknown.

blocker.description: The concrete reason for the delay or the constraint preventing acceptance, in the contact's words. Empty if none was given.

next_action.description: What the contact said they will do next or asked us to do. Empty if nothing was agreed.

certainty.description: How certain the contact sounded: high for firm statements, medium for hedged estimates, low for guesses, unknown if not reached.
